scope: LOCAL rehearsal: the packaged pinned runtime behind a local TLS proxy, synthetic Chromium pages, a simulated network interruption. Not Render, not a phone, not a real network handoff.

seen.guestDuringOutage: Connection lost. Reconnecting… Answers the game confirmed are safe. Taps made now may not arrive.
seen.guestAfterReturn: Reconnected. Answers the game confirmed are safe.
seen.guestAfterLostAnswer: the phone said it couldn't confirm the answer ("We couldn’t confirm that — check your connection. If it doesn’t show as in, try again.")

checks.name: setup: one active Casual Trivia round with a host, the guest and the TV
R1 question 1 answered and acknowledged before any interruption (locked in, recorded once)
R2 during the outage the guest's screen says it is reconnecting
checks.detail: Connection lost. Reconnecting… Answers the game confirmed are safe. Taps made now may not arrive.

checks.name: R2 during the outage the host's view marks the guest away
R2 after the network returns: socket reopened, host sees the guest back, the phone usable on question 2
R2 the SAME seat and the SAME round (same player id and name, same game, still playing)
R2 question 1's answer is still recorded, exactly once
R2 the host and the TV show the same public phase
R2b during the silent outage the app's own watchdog noticed (banner: reconnecting)
R2b after the path returns (no online event): socket reopened, host sees the guest back, the phone usable on question 2
R2b the same seat and round, question 1 still recorded once
R3 the lost-response request reached the server and was accepted
R3 while the network was down the phone did not claim the answer was in (it said it couldn't confirm)
checks.detail: the phone said it couldn't confirm the answer ("We couldn’t confirm that — check your connection. If it doesn’t show as in, try again.")

checks.name: R3 after the network returns the phone shows question 2's answer as in (the server's record)
R3 question 2 recorded exactly once (2 answers in total)
R3 replaying the very same request (same clientEventId) is answered from the dedupe and changes nothing
R3 a different second answer to question 2 is refused (ALREADY_ANSWERED), so nothing can count twice
R4 the lost first response was recovered by the phone's own retry: shown as in, recorded once (3 answers)
R5 the round finished with all 10 of the guest's answers recorded once
R5 the guest's final score equals the score of the recorded answers (nothing counted twice)
R5 the host and the TV converge on the finished round
